_about: Hand-edited site text. Update the rules, payouts, rule changes and power ranking notes here; the Tuesday job rebuilds the site from it. Source: the league Google Doc.
format: 6 teams, Weeks 15–17. Seeds 1 and 2 get a first-round bye.
1 IR slot. Maximum of 8 WRs and 8 RBs.
seeding: Division winner with the best record
Division winner with the 2nd best record
Division winner with the 3rd best record
Non-division winner with the best record
Non-division winner with the 2nd best record
Most points scored among teams not in the top 5 seeds
rematchRule: Teams that play each other twice in the postseason, in the winner's or consolation bracket, are decided by their combined points across both games. Example: Quincy 144.86 and 113.24 vs Nick 122.64 and 119.46 gives Quincy the win, 258.10 to 242.10.
transactions: $100 budget. Budgets reset to $100 at the start of the postseason, for both the playoffs and the consolation bracket.
FAAB can be included in trades.
trophies: Winner of the consolation bracket (7th place), since 2021

payouts.note: A champion who is also the highest scorer collects both payouts. The same applies to 2nd and 3rd place.

draftOrder: The order in which owners choose their draft slot, not the draft order itself:
1. Champion  2. Highest scorer (most wins breaks ties)  3. 2nd place  4. 3rd place  5. Tropny winner  6. 4th place, and so on.
If the champion is also the highest scorer, 2nd place chooses second. If the highest scorer finished in the top four, the Tropny winner chooses 5th; otherwise 6th.
New members choose last, in a random order.

changelog.label: 2026 rules vote
items: The 6th seed stays with the highest-scoring team outside the top 5, rather than best record.
FAAB budgets reset to $100 at the start of the postseason, for the playoffs and the consolation bracket.
FAAB can now be included in trades.
WR and RB limit stays at 8 per position.

changelog.label: 2022 season
items: 6th seed rule: the 6th seed goes to the highest-scoring team outside the top 5 seeds.

changelog.label: 2021 season
items: Playoff field shrinks from 8 teams to 6.
Regular season grows from 13 to 14 weeks.
The Tropny is created for the consolation bracket winner.

changelog.label: 2019 season
items: League expands from 8 teams to 12, in three divisions. Record books start here.
